articles.title: Attackers have been exploiting critical Zimbra flaw to steal emails
articles.content: A simple email gives the attackers the ability to remotely inject OS commands.
articles.titleZh: 攻击者一直在利用Zimbra的关键漏洞窃取电子邮件
articles.contentZh: 一个简单的电子邮件使攻击者能够远程注入操作系统命令。

articles.title: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates
articles.content: The move will be part of a major overhaul of the ecosystem for website authentication.

articles.title: Your uncle’s frozen Mac says it’s infected after viewing a Google ad. Now what?

articles.title: There's a new way to break RSA that's faster than anything we've seen before
articles.content: Until now, cryptographers thought factoring was the only way to break RSA. Not anymore.

articles.title: Vivo’s X Fold 6 accidentally feels like a throwback
articles.content: It's a quirk of the release calendar that when Vivo's X Fold 6 launched in China this June, it was just another foldable.
